description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2013 World Championships, its player's third world title. Darkrai-EX attacks cheaply and moves around freely, and Sableye finds the cards for the right play, making a fast, flexible deck. The 2013 World Championships were held at the Vancouver Convention Centre in Vancouver, Canada, from 9 to 11 August 2013, the first outside the United States.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2013 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
